title: Arnis turns any place on Earth into a Minecraft world
author: Alex Perrault
description: Louis Erbkamm built the first prototype in his free time. Now GitHub Copilot helps him maintain it alone. The post Arnis turns any place on Earth into a Minecraft world appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: Louis Erbkamm knows his way around Arnis, the smallest town in Germany, but he’s never set foot in it. Where the boats are… I know the city pretty well, but I haven’t been there yet.
takeaways: Louis opens a large pull request in the GitHub Copilot app for a first overview and a performance review, with Copilot running in the background looking for small changes that would cut memory usage or generation time.

I’m starting a few sub agents with the GitHub Copilot app to have a look specifically at those cases, and to come up with corner cases to test to make sure that we do not introduce any regressions into new releases.
Bigger calls happen in the open too: before porting Arnis from Python to Rust, Louis opened discussions on GitHub to hear different perspectives.
